title: Song Centre — World Music Collection
description: A curated, child-friendly collection of songs spanning Bengali, Hindi, Urdu/Pakistani and international music — from folk and classical to pop, rock and world music. All songs are educational, safe for ages 5+ and include learning notes.

songs.title: Hey Jude
songs.description: A timeless anthem of encouragement written by Paul McCartney for John Lennon's son Julian.
songs.educational_notes: Features one of the longest sing-along codas in pop music history.
songs.fun_fact: Features one of the longest sing-along codas in pop music history.

songs.title: Let It Be
songs.description: Paul McCartney's piano ballad, one of the Beatles' final singles.
songs.educational_notes: The title echoes a phrase McCartney's mother used to comfort him.
songs.fun_fact: The title echoes a phrase McCartney's mother used to comfort him.

songs.title: Yesterday
songs.description: One of the most covered songs in history, written by Paul McCartney.

songs.title: Imagine
songs.description: John Lennon's utopian anthem for peace and unity.
songs.educational_notes: Recorded at Lennon's Tittenhurst Park home studio.
songs.fun_fact: Recorded at Lennon's Tittenhurst Park home studio.

songs.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
songs.description: An operatic rock epic blending ballad, opera and hard rock sections.
songs.educational_notes: Freddie Mercury wrote it; the band spent three weeks recording the vocal harmonies.
songs.fun_fact: Freddie Mercury wrote it; the band spent three weeks recording the vocal harmonies.

songs.title: We Will Rock You
songs.description: Built on a stomp-stomp-clap rhythm that audiences worldwide replicate.
songs.educational_notes: Written by Brian May as a song the audience could perform along with the band.
songs.fun_fact: Written by Brian May as a song the audience could perform along with the band.

songs.title: Don't Stop Me Now
songs.description: An exuberant celebration of joy and freedom by Freddie Mercury.
songs.educational_notes: Voted the greatest song to make you feel happy in a UK poll.
songs.fun_fact: Voted the greatest song to make you feel happy in a UK poll.

songs.title: Rolling in the Deep
songs.description: Adele's global breakthrough smash about heartbreak and empowerment.
songs.educational_notes: Won three Grammy Awards including Record of the Year.
songs.fun_fact: Won three Grammy Awards including Record of the Year.

songs.title: Someone Like You
songs.description: A tearful piano ballad about moving on after lost love.
songs.educational_notes: Adele wrote it after a real breakup; the opening piano is now instantly recognisable.
songs.fun_fact: Adele wrote it after a real breakup; the opening piano is now instantly recognisable.

songs.title: Shape of You
songs.description: One of the best-selling singles of all time with a tropical pop sound.
songs.educational_notes: Spent 14 weeks at number 1 in the UK.
songs.fun_fact: Spent 14 weeks at number 1 in the UK.

songs.title: Perfect
songs.description: A romantic waltz-tempo ballad celebrating love.
songs.educational_notes: Inspired by Ed Sheeran's then-girlfriend Cherry Seaborn.
songs.fun_fact: Inspired by Ed Sheeran's then-girlfriend Cherry Seaborn.

songs.title: Space Oddity
songs.description: A song about astronaut Major Tom, inspired by 2001: A Space Odyssey.
songs.educational_notes: Released just days before the Apollo 11 Moon landing.
songs.fun_fact: Released just days before the Apollo 11 Moon landing.

songs.title: Heroes
songs.description: Inspired by the Berlin Wall, a song of hope between divided lovers.
songs.educational_notes: Recorded partly outdoors to capture ambient Berlin sounds.
songs.fun_fact: Recorded partly outdoors to capture ambient Berlin sounds.
awards: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

songs.title: Hotel California
songs.description: A surreal, cinematic tale of hedonism and excess in 1970s California.
songs.educational_notes: The famous guitar outro is played by Don Felder and Joe Walsh trading licks.
songs.fun_fact: The famous guitar outro is played by Don Felder and Joe Walsh trading licks.

songs.title: Take It Easy
songs.description: A laid-back anthem co-written with Jackson Browne, launching the Eagles' career.
songs.educational_notes: The corner in Winslow, Arizona mentioned in the lyrics has a commemorative statue.
songs.fun_fact: The corner in Winslow, Arizona mentioned in the lyrics has a commemorative statue.
awards: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

songs.title: Go Your Own Way
songs.description: Lindsey Buckingham's bitter breakup song directed at Stevie Nicks.
songs.educational_notes: From Rumours, one of the best-selling albums of all time.
songs.fun_fact: From Rumours, one of the best-selling albums of all time.
awards: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame

songs.title: Dreams
songs.description: Stevie Nicks' only US number 1 hit, also a viral TikTok phenomenon in 2020.
songs.educational_notes: The only song on Rumours written entirely by one member (Nicks).
songs.fun_fact: The only song on Rumours written entirely by one member (Nicks).

songs.title: Waterloo
songs.description: Won Eurovision Song Contest 1974 and launched ABBA to global stardom.
songs.educational_notes: Named after Napoleon's historic defeat at the Battle of Waterloo.
songs.fun_fact: Named after Napoleon's historic defeat at the Battle of Waterloo.

songs.title: Dancing Queen
songs.description: ABBA's only US number 1 hit, a euphoric disco anthem.
songs.educational_notes: Written in a single night by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus.
songs.fun_fact: Written in a single night by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus.

songs.title: Thriller
songs.description: The best-selling album's title track with a famous horror-film video.
songs.educational_notes: The Thriller music video is the first to be inducted into the US National Film Registry.
songs.fun_fact: The Thriller music video is the first to be inducted into the US National Film Registry.

songs.title: Billie Jean
songs.description: Michael Jackson introduced the moonwalk dance performing this song.
songs.educational_notes: Jackson spent four days mixing the song to get the bass drum sound right.
songs.fun_fact: Jackson spent four days mixing the song to get the bass drum sound right.

songs.title: Man in the Mirror
songs.description: An uplifting call for personal responsibility and social change.
songs.educational_notes: Features the Winans and Andraé Crouch Choir on backing vocals.
songs.fun_fact: Features the Winans and Andraé Crouch Choir on backing vocals.

songs.title: I Will Always Love You
songs.description: Whitney Houston's record-breaking ballad, originally written by Dolly Parton.
songs.educational_notes: Spent 14 weeks at US #1; one of the best-selling singles of all time.
songs.fun_fact: Spent 14 weeks at US #1; one of the best-selling singles of all time.

songs.title: Greatest Love of All
songs.description: An anthem celebrating self-love and belief in children's futures.
songs.educational_notes: Originally recorded by George Benson for the Muhammad Ali biopic.
songs.fun_fact: Originally recorded by George Benson for the Muhammad Ali biopic.

songs.title: Respect
songs.album: I Never Loved a Man the Way I Love You
songs.description: Aretha Franklin's feminist anthem, spelling out R-E-S-P-E-C-T.
songs.educational_notes: Originally written and recorded by Otis Redding; Franklin transformed its meaning.
songs.fun_fact: Originally written and recorded by Otis Redding; Franklin transformed its meaning.
awards: Grammy Award, Grammy Hall of Fame

songs.title: What a Wonderful World
songs.description: Louis Armstrong's gentle celebration of the beauty of the natural world.
songs.educational_notes: Became a worldwide hit after being featured in the film Good Morning, Vietnam.
songs.fun_fact: Became a worldwide hit after being featured in the film Good Morning, Vietnam.

songs.title: Summertime
songs.description: From Gershwin's opera Porgy and Bess; one of the most recorded songs ever.
songs.educational_notes: Over 33,000 cover versions have been recorded worldwide.
songs.fun_fact: Over 33,000 cover versions have been recorded worldwide.

songs.title: Fly Me to the Moon
songs.album: It Might as Well Be Swing
songs.description: Frank Sinatra's signature swing number, now synonymous with the Space Age.
songs.educational_notes: Became the first music played on the Moon during Apollo 10.
songs.fun_fact: Became the first music played on the Moon during Apollo 10.

songs.title: New York New York
songs.description: Frank Sinatra's rousing ode to ambition and New York City.
songs.educational_notes: Played at the end of every New York Yankees home game.
songs.fun_fact: Played at the end of every New York Yankees home game.

songs.title: Ring of Fire
songs.description: Johnny Cash's blazing love song co-written with June Carter.
songs.educational_notes: The mariachi-style horns were Cash's own idea, unusual for country music.
songs.fun_fact: The mariachi-style horns were Cash's own idea, unusual for country music.

songs.title: Jolene
songs.description: Dolly Parton's plea to a woman not to steal her man — a country icon.
songs.educational_notes: Inspired by a red-haired bank teller who flirted with Parton's husband.
songs.fun_fact: Inspired by a red-haired bank teller who flirted with Parton's husband.

songs.title: No Woman No Cry
songs.description: Bob Marley's comforting song to the poor of Trench Town, Kingston.
songs.educational_notes: The live version from the Lyceum, London (1975) is the most famous recording.
songs.fun_fact: The live version from the Lyceum, London (1975) is the most famous recording.

songs.title: One Love
songs.description: A joyful anthem of unity and peace, now an unofficial Jamaican national song.
songs.educational_notes: One Love/People Get Ready blends Marley's original with a Curtis Mayfield song.
songs.fun_fact: One Love/People Get Ready blends Marley's original with a Curtis Mayfield song.

songs.title: Three Little Birds
songs.description: One of reggae's most optimistic songs — 'Don't worry about a thing.'
songs.educational_notes: The 'three little birds' were real birds that would sit on Marley's windowsill.
songs.fun_fact: The 'three little birds' were real birds that would sit on Marley's windowsill.

songs.title: You Can Call Me Al
songs.description: Recorded in Johannesburg with South African musicians, blending pop and African rhythms.
songs.educational_notes: The music video features Chevy Chase lip-syncing while Simon plays.
songs.fun_fact: The music video features Chevy Chase lip-syncing while Simon plays.

songs.title: The Sound of Silence
songs.description: A haunting meditation on modern alienation and communication failure.
songs.educational_notes: Later remixed with electric instruments and became a massive hit in 1965.
songs.fun_fact: Later remixed with electric instruments and became a massive hit in 1965.

songs.title: Mrs Robinson
songs.description: Written for the film The Graduate; won Grammy for Record of the Year 1969.
songs.educational_notes: Simon wrote it in a hurry to meet the film's deadline.
songs.fun_fact: Simon wrote it in a hurry to meet the film's deadline.

songs.title: Blowin' in the Wind
songs.description: A rhetorical anthem of the civil rights and anti-war movements.
songs.educational_notes: Peter, Paul and Mary's cover reached #2 in the US, spreading the song globally.
songs.fun_fact: Peter, Paul and Mary's cover reached #2 in the US, spreading the song globally.

songs.title: Like a Rolling Stone
songs.description: Voted the greatest song of all time by Rolling Stone magazine (twice).
songs.educational_notes: Dylan wrote four pages of 'vomit' prose before shaping it into a song.
songs.fun_fact: Dylan wrote four pages of 'vomit' prose before shaping it into a song.

songs.title: Born in the USA
songs.description: A deceptively complex song about Vietnam veterans struggling at home.
songs.educational_notes: Often mistaken for a patriotic anthem; it is actually critical commentary.
songs.fun_fact: Often mistaken for a patriotic anthem; it is actually critical commentary.

songs.title: Purple Rain
songs.description: The emotional centrepiece of Prince's semi-autobiographical film of the same name.
songs.educational_notes: Prince performed it live in a real rainstorm during a famous concert.
songs.fun_fact: Prince performed it live in a real rainstorm during a famous concert.

songs.title: Like a Prayer
songs.description: A gospel-infused pop anthem blending religion, freedom and passion.
songs.educational_notes: The music video sparked significant cultural conversation about religion and race.
songs.fun_fact: The music video sparked significant cultural conversation about religion and race.

songs.title: Material Girl
songs.description: A tongue-in-cheek anthem that defined 1980s pop culture.
songs.educational_notes: The video paid homage to Marilyn Monroe's 'Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend'.
songs.fun_fact: The video paid homage to Marilyn Monroe's 'Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend'.

songs.title: Crazy in Love
songs.description: Beyoncé's debut solo single, featuring a horn sample from Chi-Lites' 'Are You My Woman'.
songs.educational_notes: Won two Grammy Awards including Best R&B Song.
songs.fun_fact: Won two Grammy Awards including Best R&B Song.

songs.title: Halo
songs.description: A sweeping power ballad about the healing power of love.
songs.educational_notes: Co-written with Ryan Tedder of OneRepublic.
songs.fun_fact: Co-written with Ryan Tedder of OneRepublic.

songs.title: Lose Yourself
songs.description: Eminem's Oscar-winning motivational anthem from the film 8 Mile.
songs.educational_notes: First rap song to win an Academy Award for Best Original Song.
songs.fun_fact: First rap song to win an Academy Award for Best Original Song.

songs.title: Under the Bridge
songs.description: Anthony Kiedis wrote it about his loneliness and drug addiction in LA.
songs.educational_notes: The bridge mentioned is the 6th Street Bridge in Los Angeles.
songs.fun_fact: The bridge mentioned is the 6th Street Bridge in Los Angeles.

songs.title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
songs.description: The defining anthem of 1990s grunge, written by Kurt Cobain.
songs.educational_notes: Kurt Cobain said he was trying to write a song that sounded like the Pixies.
songs.fun_fact: Kurt Cobain said he was trying to write a song that sounded like the Pixies.

songs.title: Wonderwall
songs.description: Noel Gallagher's acoustic classic, one of the most-played songs in UK pubs.
songs.educational_notes: 'Wonderwall' was borrowed from a 1968 George Harrison film score title.
songs.fun_fact: 'Wonderwall' was borrowed from a 1968 George Harrison film score title.

songs.title: All I Want for Christmas Is You
songs.description: The best-selling holiday single of all time, written in 15 minutes.
songs.educational_notes: Earned over $60 million in royalties for Carey and co-writer Walter Afanasieff.
songs.fun_fact: Earned over $60 million in royalties for Carey and co-writer Walter Afanasieff.

songs.title: Happy
songs.album: G I R L / Despicable Me 2
songs.description: A joyful, 24-hour music video was released with fans dancing across different hours.
songs.educational_notes: Won an Academy Award nomination for Best Original Song.
songs.fun_fact: Won an Academy Award nomination for Best Original Song.

songs.title: Get Lucky
songs.description: A retro-funk collaboration between Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers.
songs.educational_notes: Won Grammy Awards for Record of the Year and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance.
songs.fun_fact: Won Grammy Awards for Record of the Year and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance.

songs.title: Around the World
songs.description: The phrase 'around the world' is repeated 144 times, once per dancer in the video.
songs.educational_notes: Each group of dancers represents a different instrument in the track.
songs.fun_fact: Each group of dancers represents a different instrument in the track.

songs.title: La Vie en Rose
songs.description: France's most beloved song, Piaf's declaration of love-filled joy.
songs.educational_notes: Piaf wrote the lyrics herself after another songwriter provided the melody.
songs.fun_fact: Piaf wrote the lyrics herself after another songwriter provided the melody.

songs.title: Ne Me Quitte Pas
songs.description: One of the greatest songs in the French language, a heartbroken plea.
songs.educational_notes: Covered in many languages; the English version is 'If You Go Away'.
songs.fun_fact: Covered in many languages; the English version is 'If You Go Away'.

songs.title: Nessun Dorma
songs.description: The famous tenor aria from Puccini's opera Turandot, a worldwide audience favourite.
songs.educational_notes: Pavarotti's performance at the 1990 World Cup in Rome introduced it to billions.
songs.fun_fact: Pavarotti's performance at the 1990 World Cup in Rome introduced it to billions.

songs.title: The Four Seasons: Spring
songs.description: Vivaldi's most famous work, a programmatic depiction of seasonal nature sounds.
songs.educational_notes: Written in 1725 but only became widely known in the 20th century.
songs.fun_fact: Written in 1725 but only became widely known in the 20th century.

songs.title: Ode to Joy
songs.description: The finale of Beethoven's 9th Symphony, composed when he was completely deaf.
songs.educational_notes: The melody is now the official anthem of the European Union.
songs.fun_fact: The melody is now the official anthem of the European Union.

songs.title: Moonlight Sonata
songs.description: One of the most recognised piano pieces in the world, in three movements.
songs.educational_notes: The popular 'moonlight' nickname was given by critic Ludwig Rellstab after Beethoven's death.
songs.fun_fact: The popular 'moonlight' nickname was given by critic Ludwig Rellstab after Beethoven's death.

songs.title: Für Elise
songs.description: A gentle piano bagatelle, one of the first classical pieces many children learn.
songs.educational_notes: The identity of 'Elise' is still debated by music historians.
songs.fun_fact: The identity of 'Elise' is still debated by music historians.

songs.title: Eine Kleine Nachtmusik
songs.description: A playful, cheerful serenade for strings — Mozart's most popular composition.
songs.educational_notes: Written in just a few days; Mozart was working on Don Giovanni at the same time.
songs.fun_fact: Written in just a few days; Mozart was working on Don Giovanni at the same time.

songs.title: Ave Maria
songs.description: One of the most cherished sacred songs in Western classical music.
songs.educational_notes: Based on a poem from Sir Walter Scott's narrative poem The Lady of the Lake.
songs.fun_fact: Based on a poem from Sir Walter Scott's narrative poem The Lady of the Lake.

songs.title: Clair de Lune
songs.description: The third movement of Debussy's Suite bergamasque — dreamy and luminous.
songs.educational_notes: The title means 'moonlight' in French, inspired by a Paul Verlaine poem.
songs.fun_fact: The title means 'moonlight' in French, inspired by a Paul Verlaine poem.

songs.title: Smooth
songs.description: Carlos Santana's Grammy-sweeping collaboration with Rob Thomas of Matchbox Twenty.
songs.educational_notes: Won three Grammy Awards in a single night including Record of the Year.
songs.fun_fact: Won three Grammy Awards in a single night including Record of the Year.

songs.title: Oye Como Va
songs.description: A classic Tito Puente composition reinvented by Santana with rock guitar.
songs.educational_notes: Tito Puente originally wrote it in 1963; Santana's version made it a global hit.
songs.fun_fact: Tito Puente originally wrote it in 1963; Santana's version made it a global hit.

songs.title: La Bamba
songs.description: A traditional Mexican folk song transformed into rock and roll by Ritchie Valens.
songs.educational_notes: Became a Top 25 hit despite most US radio listeners not understanding Spanish.
songs.fun_fact: Became a Top 25 hit despite most US radio listeners not understanding Spanish.

songs.title: Livin' la Vida Loca
songs.description: The Latin pop explosion that launched a global Latin music wave in 1999.
songs.educational_notes: Became the first #1 single of the SoundScan/BDS monitored era in Latin pop.
songs.fun_fact: Became the first #1 single of the SoundScan/BDS monitored era in Latin pop.

songs.title: Waka Waka (This Time for Africa)
songs.description: The official song of the 2010 FIFA World Cup held in South Africa.
songs.educational_notes: Based on a Cameroonian army chant called 'Zangalewa'.
songs.fun_fact: Based on a Cameroonian army chant called 'Zangalewa'.

songs.title: Hips Don't Lie
songs.description: One of the best-selling singles of all time, blending Latin and Caribbean rhythms.
songs.educational_notes: Spent over 55 weeks on the Billboard charts.
songs.fun_fact: Spent over 55 weeks on the Billboard charts.

songs.title: Guantanamera
songs.description: Cuba's most famous song, based on José Martí's patriotic poetry.
songs.educational_notes: Literally means 'woman from Guantánamo'; the melody is drawn from a Cuban son.
songs.fun_fact: Literally means 'woman from Guantánamo'; the melody is drawn from a Cuban son.

songs.title: Chan Chan
songs.description: The opening track of the Grammy-winning Buena Vista Social Club album.
songs.educational_notes: Written by Compay Segundo; the repetitive bass riff is iconic in Cuban music.
songs.fun_fact: Written by Compay Segundo; the repetitive bass riff is iconic in Cuban music.

songs.title: Mas Que Nada
songs.album: Herb Alpert Presents Sérgio Mendes & Brasil '66
songs.description: A bossa nova classic composed by Jorge Ben Jor, popularised globally by Sérgio Mendes.
songs.educational_notes: The 2006 Black Eyed Peas remix brought it to a new generation.
songs.fun_fact: The 2006 Black Eyed Peas remix brought it to a new generation.

songs.title: The Girl from Ipanema
songs.description: The song that introduced bossa nova to the world — the second most recorded song ever.
songs.educational_notes: Astrud Gilberto's English vocal was recorded spontaneously in the studio.
songs.fun_fact: Astrud Gilberto's English vocal was recorded spontaneously in the studio.

songs.title: Lambada
songs.description: The global dance hit of 1989 that sparked a lambada dance craze worldwide.
songs.educational_notes: Based on a Bolivian huayno melody; the original composers won a copyright lawsuit.
songs.fun_fact: Based on a Bolivian huayno melody; the original composers won a copyright lawsuit.

songs.title: Pata Pata
songs.description: Miriam Makeba's joyful signature song, originally recorded in 1956.
songs.educational_notes: The title is Xhosa slang for 'touch touch'; the dance mimics the meaning.
songs.fun_fact: The title is Xhosa slang for 'touch touch'; the dance mimics the meaning.

songs.title: Click Song (Qongqothwane)
songs.description: Famous for its Xhosa click consonants, showcasing the richness of African languages.
songs.educational_notes: Makeba performed it at John F. Kennedy's birthday gala in 1962.
songs.fun_fact: Makeba performed it at John F. Kennedy's birthday gala in 1962.

songs.title: 7 Seconds
songs.description: A duet celebrating the innocence of children before the world shapes their views.
songs.educational_notes: Topped charts in France and many European countries for weeks.
songs.fun_fact: Topped charts in France and many European countries for weeks.

songs.title: Agolo
songs.description: A powerful tribute to Mother Earth blending West African rhythms with pop.
songs.educational_notes: Kidjo went on to win multiple Grammy Awards; Agolo remains her signature song.
songs.fun_fact: Kidjo went on to win multiple Grammy Awards; Agolo remains her signature song.

songs.title: Sweet Mother
songs.description: One of the best-selling African singles of all time — a tribute to mothers.
songs.educational_notes: Sold over 13 million copies, making it one of the biggest African hits ever.
songs.fun_fact: Sold over 13 million copies, making it one of the biggest African hits ever.

songs.title: Ye
songs.description: A contemporary Afrobeats anthem about contentment and gratitude.
songs.educational_notes: Helped launch Burna Boy's international breakthrough.
songs.fun_fact: Helped launch Burna Boy's international breakthrough.

songs.title: Jana Gana Mana
songs.description: India's national anthem, composed by Rabindranath Tagore in Bengali.
songs.educational_notes: First sung at the Calcutta session of the Indian National Congress in 1911.
songs.fun_fact: First sung at the Calcutta session of the Indian National Congress in 1911.

songs.title: Jai Ho
songs.description: Academy Award-winning song from the film Slumdog Millionaire.
songs.educational_notes: A.R. Rahman won two Oscars for the film's music, a first for Indian music.
songs.fun_fact: A.R. Rahman won two Oscars for the film's music, a first for Indian music.

songs.title: Roja Jaaneman
songs.description: The title song from the groundbreaking Mani Ratnam film that launched A.R. Rahman.
songs.educational_notes: Won the National Film Award and made Rahman a household name across India.
songs.fun_fact: Won the National Film Award and made Rahman a household name across India.

songs.title: Teri Mitti
songs.description: An emotional tribute to soldiers, sung by the nightingale of India, Lata Mangeshkar.
songs.educational_notes: Won the Filmfare Award for Best Lyricist and deeply moved audiences across India.
songs.fun_fact: Won the Filmfare Award for Best Lyricist and deeply moved audiences across India.

songs.title: Awara Hoon
songs.description: One of the most globally popular Bollywood songs, especially loved in Soviet Russia and China.
songs.educational_notes: The film Awaara was one of the highest-grossing films worldwide in 1951.
songs.fun_fact: The film Awaara was one of the highest-grossing films worldwide in 1951.

songs.title: Gangnam Style
songs.description: First YouTube video to reach 1 billion views; launched the global K-pop wave.
songs.educational_notes: Named after the Gangnam district of Seoul, known for its wealthy lifestyle.
songs.fun_fact: Named after the Gangnam district of Seoul, known for its wealthy lifestyle.

songs.title: Dynamite
songs.description: BTS's first all-English single, released during the COVID-19 pandemic to spread joy.
songs.educational_notes: Debuted at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100, a first for a Korean act.
songs.fun_fact: Debuted at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100, a first for a Korean act.

songs.title: Butter
songs.description: A feel-good summer anthem that broke multiple streaming records.
songs.educational_notes: Spent 10 consecutive weeks at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.
songs.fun_fact: Spent 10 consecutive weeks at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

songs.title: Sakura
songs.description: A beloved Japanese song about cherry blossoms and farewell — deeply tied to graduation season.
songs.educational_notes: Consistently ranked among Japan's most-loved songs of the 2000s.
songs.fun_fact: Consistently ranked among Japan's most-loved songs of the 2000s.

songs.title: Ue o Muite Arukō (Sukiyaki)
songs.description: The only Japanese-language song to reach #1 on the US Billboard Hot 100.
songs.educational_notes: Billboard renamed it 'Sukiyaki' — a Japanese dish — as the real title was hard to market.
songs.fun_fact: Billboard renamed it 'Sukiyaki' — a Japanese dish — as the real title was hard to market.

songs.title: Enta Omri
songs.description: One of the greatest Arabic songs ever written — a live performance typically lasted hours.
songs.educational_notes: Umm Kulthum would repeat verses spontaneously based on audience response.
songs.fun_fact: Umm Kulthum would repeat verses spontaneously based on audience response.

songs.title: Nassam Alayna Al-Hawa
songs.description: One of Fairuz's most beloved melodies, evoking longing and nostalgia.
songs.educational_notes: Fairuz is considered the most important Arab female singer of the 20th century.
songs.fun_fact: Fairuz is considered the most important Arab female singer of the 20th century.

songs.title: Habibi Ya Nour El Ain
songs.description: Blending Egyptian pop with Mediterranean and Western influences — a global Arabic pop hit.
songs.educational_notes: Won the World Music Award for Best Selling Middle Eastern Artist.
songs.fun_fact: Won the World Music Award for Best Selling Middle Eastern Artist.

songs.title: Zombie
songs.description: A protest song about the Troubles in Northern Ireland, written by Dolores O'Riordan.
songs.educational_notes: Written after two young boys were killed in an IRA bomb attack in Warrington.
songs.fun_fact: Written after two young boys were killed in an IRA bomb attack in Warrington.

songs.title: Linger
